retrieval_quality.note: hit_rate@10 = fraction of queries with >=1 known-relevant document in the top 10 (a lenient hit-rate, NOT the standard Recall@10 which averages the fraction of ALL relevant docs retrieved per query). mrr_at_10 = mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant hit (0 if none in top 10). Judged against BeIR/nfcorpus-qrels (test split, sparse human judgments — not every relevant doc is necessarily labeled).
